text.p: - Russian Minister for Foreign Affairs Yevgeny Primakov said during his visit to Switzerland, where he met Swiss president Jean-Pascal Delamuraz and foreign minister Flavio Cotti that he considered the peace treaty with Chechnya a 'big step forward'. He also said that he was committed to strengthening the OSCE.

- A study of the University of St Gallen predicted a 1.0 percent increase of the Swiss gross domestic product in 1997. It forecast unemployment at 4.5 percent and an annual inflation rate of 1.7 percent in 1997.

- Germany's second lagest drug-store chain 'Ihr Platz' plans to open three to five stores in Switzerland in 1997. - Swiss high-tech and hearing aid devices maker Phonak reported a 33.4 percent rise in net profit to 17.7 million Swiss francs in fiscal 1995/96.
- The Swiss Federal Office for Statistics cut its estimate of Switzerland's 1995 economic growth to 0.1 percent from 0.7 percent.
- Forest damage in Switzerland has trippled since 1985. In 1995, some 25 percent of all trees showed signs of some damage.
